errors.text_span: The bar chart presents two sets of performance metrics for four different models—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—across two axes: Accuracy (%) on the left vertical axis and Token Count on the right vertical axis. The horizontal axis displays the four model categories, arranged in the order CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, as indicated by the legend at the bottom.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly portrays the chart as a single dual-axis plot where each of four bars corresponds to values on both the left and right y-axes. The chart actually consists of two separate groups of bars side-by-side: a group of four bars for 'Accuracy (%)' and another group of four bars for 'Token Count'. There are a total of eight bars, not four.

errors.text_span: This bar chart, titled “Accuracy (%)” on the left y-axis and “Token Count” on the right y-axis
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a single title, nor are the titles located on the y-axes. The chart has two section titles, 'Accuracy (%)' and 'Token Count', located at the top of the two respective groups of bars. The y-axes are labeled with the same text, but they are axis labels, not chart titles.

errors.text_span: The bars are arranged in a single group per model, with each model’s accuracy bar on the left and its token count bar on the right, visually aligned by color.
errors.evidence: The chart is not structured in groups per model. It consists of two separate sets of bars. The first four bars on the left represent the 'Accuracy' for each of the four models. The second four bars on the right represent the 'Token Count' for each of the four models. The accuracy bar and token count bar for a single model are not adjacent.

errors.text_span: presented in the order of CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT from left to right
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate description of the overall bar order. The sequence of models 'CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT' is presented once for the 'Accuracy' bars and then repeated for the 'Token Count' bars. The description incorrectly implies this sequence applies to the entire chart from left to right, which would mean there are only four bars in total.

errors.text_span: Jede Methode ist durch zwei nebeneinander angeordnete Balken dargestellt, wobei der linke Balken die Genauigkeit in Prozent misst und der rechte Balken den Token-Zähler anzeigt.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that bars are grouped by method, with an accuracy bar and a token count bar placed next to each other for each method. In reality, the chart consists of two separate groups of bars: one group for 'Accuracy' and one for 'Token Count'. Within each group, there is one bar for each of the four methods.

errors.text_span: Die linke vertikale Achse ist mit „Accuracy (%)“ beschriftet
errors.evidence: The label 'Accuracy (%)' is the title for the left-hand group of bars, not the label for the left vertical axis, which is unlabeled.

errors.text_span: Die rechte vertikale Achse ist mit „Token Count“ beschriftet
errors.evidence: The label 'Token Count' is the title for the right-hand group of bars, not the label for the right vertical axis, which is unlabeled.

errors.text_span: wobei jede Methode zwei Balken in der gleichen Farbe enthält, die jeweils die Genauigkeit und den Token-Zähler repräsentieren.
errors.evidence: This statement repeats the fundamental misunderstanding of the chart's structure. The chart does not contain two bars of the same color per method to represent accuracy and token count side-by-side. Instead, one bar for each method appears in the 'Accuracy' section, and another bar for the same method appears separately in the 'Token Count' section.
